scope: All 25 playable Melee captain resources; excludes flagship, Sa-Matra, and campaign old Shofixti.
coordinate_convention: ANI fields: filename transparent_color colormap_index hotspot_x hotspot_y. Overlay top-left relative to portrait is negative hotspot. Rectangles use exclusive right/bottom.

special_cases.shofixti: 20 ANI rows, 12 unique PNGs. Special base index12; release handling advances the latched lever. special_offset5 triggers self_destruct; PostProcessStatus draws DecFrameIndex(background), row19, at explosion start. Preserve rows15–19 and all aliases.
special_cases.chmmr: 12 unique PNGs: thrust and weapon have distinct rest, transition, held PNGs.
special_cases.vux: 9 unique PNGs: right_held index1 and left_held index5 share intruder-cap-001.png.
special_cases.all: Damage/death rectangles and flashes are procedural status drawing, not additional captain PNGs. No ambient idle loop is present in native captain control.
